question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Which cannot be read.
solution:
The correct one-word substitute is: **Illegible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term refers to text that is difficult or impossible to read due to poor handwriting or print.
 
• **"Illegible" **refers to writing or print that cannot be read due to poor handwriting or print quality. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **​****For example:** His handwriting was so poor it was almost illegible.
 
 

Therefore, "illegible" is the appropriate term to describe something that cannot be read.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Illiterate"** describes a person who is unable to read or write. (अनपढ़)

 
 
• **​****For example:** The program aims to educate adult illiterate individuals.
 
 
 
• **"Inaudible"** refers to sound that cannot be heard. (अश्राव्य)
 
 
• **​****For example:** His whisper was inaudible over the sound of the crowd.
 
 
 
• **"Invisible"** means something that cannot be seen. (अदृश्य)
 
 
• **​****For example: **The gas is invisible to the naked eye.
